walkthroughs.title: Get started with Detection Rule Atlas
walkthroughs.description: Open a sample rule file, see its rule summary, syntax check and metadata check, and try the Pro quality review and ATT&CK coverage in the free 14-day trial.

steps.title: Open a sample file
steps.description:
Detection Rule Atlas reads YARA rules (text, hex and regular expression strings with a condition) and Sigma rules (YAML with a log source and a detection). The samples are invented lab rules with typical mistakes, so every report has something to show.
[Open Sample File](command:detectionRuleAtlas.openSample)

steps.title: Run Show Rule Summary
steps.description:
Every rule at a glance: YARA rules with tags, strings and meta fields, or Sigma rules with status, level and log source. The report opens as a new Markdown document; your file is not changed.
[Show Rule Summary](command:detectionRuleAtlas.showSummary)

steps.title: Use the other free reports
steps.description:
Every free report works without a key, an account or a network connection: Show Syntax Check, Show Metadata Check.
[Show Syntax Check](command:detectionRuleAtlas.showSyntax)
[Show Metadata Check](command:detectionRuleAtlas.showMetadata)

steps.title: Try Pro free for 14 days
steps.description:
The first Pro command you run starts a free 14-day trial on this computer, with no key and no network: Show Quality Review, Show ATT&CK Coverage.
[Show Quality Review](command:detectionRuleAtlas.showQuality)

steps.title: Licence and help
steps.description:
Buy Pro (Personal USD 19, Business USD 39 per user), enter a key, see the licence status, or report a problem.
[Show Licence Status](command:detectionRuleAtlas.licenceStatus)
[Report A Problem](command:detectionRuleAtlas.reportProblem)

detectionRuleAtlas.maxFileSizeMB.markdownDescription: Largest file (in MB) a report reads, up to 50 MB (VS Code passes files only up to 50 MB to extensions). Larger files are refused with a message.

detectionRuleAtlas.openReportsAsPreview.markdownDescription: Open each report in the Markdown preview as well as in a new editor.
